import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { oauthAccessGrants } from "./oauth_access_grants";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to oauth_access_grants (its only ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "nonce" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const oauthOpenidRequests = defineTable("oauth_openid_requests", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        accessGrantId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        nonce: col.text().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        accessGrant: rel.belongsTo(() => oauthAccessGrants, { onDelete: "cascade" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
